results.title: Specification - Model Context Protocol
results.snippet: ModelContextProtocol(MCP) is an openprotocolthat enables seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources and tools. Whether you're building an AI-powered IDE, enhancing a chat interface, or creating custom AI workflows, MCP provides a standardized way to connect LLMs with thecontextthey need.
